title: Jamie's Totem Switcher
description: A lightweight Totem mod that moves a Totem of Undying from your inventory to your offhand using a customizable hotkey.
body:
# Jamie’s Totem Switcher
## Overview

Press R (default) to instantly move a Totem of Undying into your offhand. Press it again to switch it back. Works in survival without opening any menus.

## Features
- One key toggles totem between inventory and offhand
- Works with hotbar and main inventory
- Uses hotbar first for faster swapping
- Simple swap back with same key
## How to use

Press R while in game with no screen open (no inventory, chest, etc).
The totem moves to your offhand instantly.
Press R again to return it to the original slot.

## Tips
- Put a totem in your hotbar for fastest swaps
- Only works in survival mode and when no GUI is open

## Limitations
- Survival only
- Won’t work while any screen is open

WE ARE NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR ANY BANS. THIS MOD IS NOT INTENDED FOR BREAKING RULES. USE AT YOUR OWN RISK.
